issues.detail: Acquired text retains historic magistrate/synod powers. It is not the current OPC American-revised form.
No Proofs or AnswerWithProofs fields. Do not synthesize proofs from WLC, Baptist or current OPC editions.

20 is wrongly titled Christian Liberty instead of Gospel; 21 has Consciencey typo; 25 repeats Civil Magistrate instead of Marriage. Parallel CC0 witnesses retain distinct titles. Originals not altered.
1688 is date of exercises, not scanned edition date. Digital wording is modernized (you/your); source/editor not established; do not identify it as a faithful 1767 transcription.
1677 composition/publication label and 1689 reception name retained; preface, signatories and baptism appendix are not separate acquired text units.
Source attributes 1695 witness to William Collins. Do not silently retitle it Keach 1693 or merge with 1794 witnesses.
The single adoption paragraph has no printed numeral in Markdown. Preserve unnumbered label; parallel JSON calls it paragraph 1.
